decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent hardware product that stayed prominent on the home page across both years, the electrometer likely supports the firm's trusted dosimetry position and should remain in the portfolio.
The oncology risk management software fits the firm's strategy of integrated, automated QA workflows and its continued dedicated web presence suggests it is strategically important.
A CT image quality test phantom extends the firm's established imaging QA offer with clear technical and customer fit, so it is sensible to continue building this line.
Although more distant from the historic core, the mammography image quality phantom still complements the firm's broader medical imaging QA expansion and is too new to exit quickly in a growing firm.

The full field mammography test phantom broadens the imaging QA range for adjacent customers and likely benefits from the firm's calibration, support, and sales capabilities despite being farther from the core.
Medical imaging QA instruments are well aligned with the firm's independent measurement and support strengths, making them a natural product family to retain.
